content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIIT Sri City Electrician Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Information Technology, Sri City, Chittoor (IIIT Sri City) located in Andhra Pradesh for filling up outsourcing staff positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under this notification?
faq.answer: The notification has been released for the recruitment of the Electrician post, specifically requiring a valid 33 kV electrical licence for maintenance operations.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in IIIT Sri City Electrician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Electrician position under this recruitment drive announced by IIIT Sri City.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Electrician post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an ITI in Electrician Trade or a Diploma in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics engineering along with a valid 33 kV electrical licence.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Electrician post is preferably not exceeding 45 years as specified in the official notification details.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting applications via email to the designated address is 05-10-2026. Candidates must ensure submission prior to this deadline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for IIIT Sri City Electrician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Email. Interested candidates need to send their updated resumes and required documents to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply for this job?
faq.answer: No application fee has been prescribed or mentioned in the official notification released by IIIT Sri City for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Electrician position?
faq.answer: The selection process includes application scrutiny, shortlisting based on qualifications and 33 kV licence, technical assessment, and a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type and salary structure for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The position is offered on an outsourcing contract basis with remuneration structured as per outsourcing norms defined by the institution.
